checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sneaker in original side view, fully inside frame
must.why: Same pose and position, fully in frame.
Stitching, eyelets, laces and sole pattern preserved; collar slightly altered.

must.item: Grey floor and clutter replaced by seamless white setting
must.why: Clutter is gone and the background is seamless, but it is light grey rather than white.

must.item: Soft shadow beneath sneaker without visible floor boundary
must.why: Soft subtle shadow, no hard horizon line.
Image is 640x384 (about 5:3), not 16:9. No text added.

faults.what: Background is light grey, not white as the brief requires.
Shoe interior and collar are slightly redrawn and differ from the original.

summary: The sneaker is cleanly isolated on a seamless light-grey studio background with a soft shadow, but the background is grey rather than white and the frame is not 16:9.
